summary: Re-running setup does not remove instances. Stop services on the instance (automation-controller-service stop), run `awx-manage deprovision_instance --hostname=<name>` from another instance, then restart the rest; instance groups are not removed automatically.
questions: How do I remove a node from a controller cluster?
Does re-running setup remove old instances?

answer_card.title: Deprovision a controller instance
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
automation-controller-service stop                     # on the instance being removed
awx-manage deprovision_instance --hostname=hostB       # from another instance
automation-controller-service start                    # on remaining instances
```
Use the inventory hostname. Instance groups are not removed automatically.
